title: Fix batch — error lines, buttons, notices

steps.path: Example: Assistant settings → Cloud providers, a rejected OpenRouter key
steps.headline: How should a short error line look?

variants.label: Today: red text
variants.summary: The sentence itself is red. The guide says never red body text, so today's look breaks that rule.

variants.label: Grey text, red icon
variants.summary: Normal grey text with a small red warning icon in front. Only the icon carries the colour; it takes no more space than today.

variants.label: Small tinted box
variants.summary: The same text in a small red-tinted box: a mini version of the notice box used everywhere else. Most noticeable, and it takes a little more space.

steps.notice: Every short error line in the app (sign-in failures, a request that didn't go through, a save that failed…) now goes through this one piece, so your pick changes all of them at once. Bigger notices keep the full notice box.

steps.headline: Archive and Delete as outlined buttons — keep?
steps.changed: Archive and Delete were plain text beside each tag; now they're outlined buttons. Delete's confirm step uses the red button, like other deletes.
steps.notice: Each tag row gets a little wider on the right; nothing else moves.

steps.headline: Go incognito as an outlined button — keep?
steps.changed: "Go Incognito" was plain text; now it's an outlined button reading "Go incognito". The lobby's other small actions (Dismiss, Cancel, Retry) change the same way.
steps.notice: The friends-panel redesign you asked for is still to come; this only fixes today's buttons.

steps.headline: The billing warning as the standard notice box — keep?
steps.changed: The billing box ("Billed per …") was hand-made with an orange title and a ⚠ character; it's now the app's standard warning notice box, same text.
steps.notice: The orange "Enable & accept charges" button stays as it is: it's deliberately a billing-warning colour.
